classification: W4/W5 integration design added in this change; not part of the historical 0001 baseline
invariants: No business Operation, receipt or result is created for an ordinary read-only tool.
One tool_call_id per attempt; identity and terminal projection are immutable.
Source assistant toolCall, model request observation and result native entry are explicitly linked.
Only the closed public projection enters the frozen product event; native links and raw payloads stay private.
Projection row/version and its reliable outbox event are committed in the same transaction.
An ended attempt cannot retain a running tool projection; stop, budget and isolated recovery settle it.
A failed/cancelled first projection can describe a native call that was not dispatched; it does not add authorization counters.
0001 remains byte-for-byte unchanged; upgrading requires the explicit dedicated Agent migration command.
validation: Not executed in this change. Await user confirmation before checks, migration, services or tests.
